name: Bogács (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, red and blue in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre of the red with the municipal arms of Bogács (a crowned blue shield with yellow figures and white ploughshares) below the name BOGÁCS in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
